description: The combined squares-and-roots candidate received 4 essential votes, while conceptual recovery of a side from its square received 2 essential and 3 helpful. The concepts and misconceptions assessors treated side recovery differently between these overlapping candidates. The scope distinction between understanding the identity and using it to find a side remains unresolved. Original votes are preserved.
The 10 essential classifications are overlapping candidate competencies, not 10 distinct lessons. The teacher-facing summary groups related ideas; it does not combine or manufacture their votes.
